name: ChimiaClaw — echo signed artifact
description: Reference KeeperHub workflow that takes a ChimiaClaw artifact id plus optional payload metadata and emits a deterministic acknowledgement transaction. Recommended for the first end-to-end signed schedule → status round-trip without spending real funds beyond gas.

inputs.name: payload_hash
inputs.description: Optional payload Blake3 digest from PayloadRef.hash; pass-through only.

steps.name: log-input
steps.message: ChimiaClaw KeeperHub echo step received artifact_id={{inputs.artifact_id}} mode={{inputs.mode}}

notes: If you do not want to deploy a receipt contract yet, replace the emit-receipt step with a kind: 'log' step. The Rust client tolerates a missing tx_hash and reports it as null in the signed status artifact.
ChimiaClaw policy: never wire this workflow to a contract that moves funds without an explicit operator-confirmation step in front of it.
